cases.description: Every skill has routeable frontmatter.
/webnovel-init keeps the deep collection gate and avoids writing canon before confirmation.
required: 未过充分性闸门，不执行 `webnovel.py init`

cases.description: /webnovel-plan runs the volume planning dialogue and decision-card gate before producing volume-only planning artifacts, after a master-to-volume direction check that only the last volume may be planned.
required: 若发现总纲与设定冲突，先阻断
只允许生成**最后一卷**的卷纲

cases.description: /webnovel-chapter-plan runs the per-batch chapter planning dialogue and decision-card gate before creating independent chapter outlines and refreshing chapter contracts; chapters that already have an outline or body are never regenerated, and the batch is direction-checked against its volume.
required: 大纲/第{volume_id}卷-章纲规划讨论.md
已有章纲或正文的章一律不生成、不覆盖

cases.description: /webnovel-volume-revise confirms impact before editing, shares the planning-dialogue option wording, and reloads the volume revision afterward; existing chapter outlines and bodies are locked facts, and only the last volume may be revised.
required: 章纲锁定即意味着正文同样不动
只允许修改最后一卷的卷纲

cases.description: Manual volume outline edits require explicit revision reload and stale propagation; only the last volume may be reloaded, and the reload records a master-to-volume direction check.
required: 只允许重载最后一卷的卷纲

cases.description: Manual body edits require revision-bound reload, validation, and explicit commit confirmation; only the last chapter body may be edited, enforced by the chapter-to-body direction boundary.
required: 只能修改最后一章正文

cases.description: Discarding a chapter is tail-only: drafts are archived then deleted; accepted chapters restore the previous version point in place on the current branch, without creating a new branch or rewriting history.
/webnovel-write calls runtime gates at natural boundaries.
/webnovel-review preserves five-dimensional fact review without editorial scoring.
required: 必须通过 `Agent` 工具调用 `reviewer`
章节事实一致性与逻辑审查
不评分、不评价文笔、不建议情节改动

cases.description: /webnovel-query stays read-only and prioritizes Story System sources.
required: 只读操作，不修改任何项目文件

cases.description: /webnovel-learn writes through the project-memory CLI instead of manual JSON edits.
/webnovel-dashboard remains read-only and exposes runtime health.
/webnovel-doctor stays read-only and uses project-status before detailed checks.
/webnovel-write keeps blocking review issues before commit and calls runtime gates.
data-agent produces commit artifacts and does not directly write projection read-models.
reviewer returns JSON while main flow writes review_results.json; data-agent writes only tmp artifacts.
ChapterCommitService remains the projection driver.
Dashboard exposes GET-only API semantics.
/webnovel-write --minimal final report explains skipped reviewer instead of pretending full review passed.
Missing data-agent artifacts prevent a completed write report.
Projection retry success is reported as auto-handled.
Reviewer blocking issues are reported as must-handle.
/webnovel-audit stays read-only, discloses threshold provenance, and refuses to conclude on insufficient samples.
/webnovel-style-learn separates observed from target, defaults to accepted commits, and keeps script output out of manual edits.
